description: This PHP test source file defines a unit test class for the KpiDao data access object within the OrangeHRM Performance plugin. It verifies CRUD operations and logic related to KPI entities for the performance management module.

classes.name: KpiDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the KpiDao's functionality related to KPI management in the Performance module of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, instantiates KpiDao, and populates test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testSaveKpi
methods.description: Tests saving a new KPI entity and ensures the saved entity matches the original.

methods.name: testGetKpiById
methods.description: Tests retrieving KPI entities by ID, including both existing and non-existing IDs.

methods.name: testGetKpiList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of KPIs with and without filters.

methods.name: testGetKpiCount
methods.description: Tests counting KPI entities with different filters.

methods.name: testDeleteKpi
methods.description: Tests deleting KPIs by IDs and verifies the count of deleted items.

methods.name: testUnsetDefaultKpi
methods.description: Tests unsetting the default KPI in the database.

methods.name: testUnsetDefaultKpiWithId
methods.description: Tests unsetting the default KPI by a specific ID.

methods.name: testGetDefaultKpi
methods.description: Tests retrieving the default KPI entity.
